links.comparator_used: Original random survival forest model trained on 2007-2017 data and not refit (static), evaluated on the 2020 cohort
links.outcome: Discrimination (C-index) and calibration on the 2020 cohort
links.effect: Without refitting, C-index ranged from 0.69 to 0.84 depending on imputation method; with refitting, it ranged from 0.79 to 0.83. Calibration improved markedly with refitting.

design_hint: model refitting and imputation strategies for deployment
